lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×10

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: As promised, your reward.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: So you were unable to find the body?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: She was such an intelligent child. Very healthy as well. Such a shame.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Nevertheless, thank you for your help.
Did you read what was on the paper?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Yes, I did.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Sometimes the delinquents will spread malicious rumors amongst the other children.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: She must have believed what she heard, and chose to run away.
What kind of rumors?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: That we capture children and mistreat them.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: They also say we turn them into Nikkes when they become adults.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Utter nonsense, of course.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: We have our own ways of handling such issues.
... Tell me, where exactly is your center located?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I'm afraid it's getting late. I must get back to work.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Thank you again.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Keep in touch.
Wait!
It's a restricted account.
